name: Duin & Dorp AI Operations Portfolio

flows.purpose: Extract intent and evidence from an untrusted enquiry.
Explain blocked cases and propose a safe next step.
Extract source-cited property facts from text or TXT/Markdown for human review.

operating_principles: Every external write is owned by the outbox, not an LLM.
Every model result is schema-validated; workbench runs expose safe provider metadata.
No credentials, raw customer email, or hidden prompts in the browser.
Provider failure is visible; it never becomes a false success.
